releaseNotes:
- FTP session stays connected when switching pages (Settings, Dashboard)
- Header: theme in the hamburger menu, outline nav icons, Deploy title bar removed
- Redesigned app dialogs (themed overlay)
- Multiple FTP profiles per project, favorites, and default target before Commit and Sync
- FTP editor: compact themed tab close; Refresh from remote (toolbar and right-click) with unsaved-change confirm
- Upload success banner auto-hides after a few seconds
- Standalone Terminal page removed (use the Deploy dock terminal)
- Dark theme: connection Name field caret is visible
